policy: Known production unsafe surface, per file. Counts were captured on 2026-09-12 after documenting every site with a '// SAFETY:' note or a '# Safety' doc section (see scripts/unsafe-scan.mjs). This file is a RATCHET: adding an unsafe site to an existing file, or introducing a new file with unsafe, fails the gate until the addition is acknowledged here. Lowering a count is reported as stale so the file cannot rot. The sites are, in practice, FFI/JNI glue for the Android platform APIs plus 'unsafe impl Send/Sync' for handles that must be moved across threads.
